sections.title: Codex Evolution & The Next Generation / Codex 进化与下一代
sections.desc: Sottiaux 预告下一代模型（**7715 赞**）+ Luna 降价永久性（**3100 赞**）+ 10 亿用户 PR（**4091 赞**）。

rewrite: Sottiaux's evolution teaser (7715 likes): 'Given some of the results I'm seeing recently, it's pretty clear Codex is a good harness. But it will seem primitive in 2-3 months and we're about to go through another major evolution in how we use AI at the frontier. The next generation of models need more than your laptop.' Plus his permanence clarification (3100 likes): 'The GPT-5.6 Luna price reduction by 80% is not a temporary stunt, it's permanent. Efficiency gains don't go away.' Plus his shipping pride (4091 likes): 'Crazy thing about OpenAI is you just open your laptop, codex a PR into existence and ship an improvement to 1B users. Just like that.'

sections.title: Alignment vs Harmless, Open Source Passion & Builder Wisdom / 对齐与无害、开源热情与构建者智慧
sections.desc: Amanda Askell 论对齐与无害是不同轴（**989 赞**）；Peter Yang 的 Hermes 总结（138 赞）+ 开源热情（24 赞）；Levie 论开源追赶（57 赞）；Dan Shipper 的深度访谈（**179 赞**）；Aditya 的「只管去做」（51 赞）。

cards.authorTag: Anthropic / Builder / Box CEO / Every CEO / SPC

rewrite: Amanda Askell on alignment vs harmlessness (989 likes): 'I don't agree with this. Models (like humans) can behave in aligned ways while still causing harm, e.g. because they're given false information about their situation. There isn't a line between aligned and harmless: they're different axes.' Plus her hereditary peerage joke (101 likes).

Peter Yang's Hermes takeaways (138 likes): 6 lessons including 'The personal in personal agent is not the model. It's the agent's memory of your conversations and the skills you've built with it.' Plus his open source passion post (24 likes) quoting Karan: 'We want open source to win. We need to give this level of intelligence to everyone.' Levie on open weights (57 likes): 'If you had gone back even 3-6 months and given everyone access to what we're now seeing in open weights even as a closed model, their minds would be completely blown.'

Dan Shipper's deep interview (179 likes). Aditya's 'just do things' philosophy (51 likes): 'If you see something you think can be better, just make it happen. How did Shreepoorna build a flight-worthy aircraft in 150 days? By just doing things. Engines. Avionics. Fucking just do it.' Plus Nikunj's dad stealth exit (59 likes) and Zara's Codex trip-planning tip (3 likes).
original: Amanda Askell: Models (like humans) can behave in aligned ways while still causing harm. There isn't a line between aligned and harmless: they're different axes.
Peter Yang: The personal in personal agent is not the model. It's the agent's memory of your conversations and the skills you've built with it.
Aaron Levie: If you had gone back even 3-6 months and given everyone access to what we're now seeing in open weights even as a closed model, their minds would be completely blown.
Aditya Agarwal: If you see something you think can be better, just make it happen. Engines. Avionics. Fucking just do it.

rewrite: Amanda Askell 论对齐与无害（989 赞）：我不同意这个观点。模型（如同人类）可以以对齐的方式行为，但仍然造成伤害，例如因为它们被给了关于自己处境的错误信息。对齐和无害之间没有一条线：它们是不同的轴。加上她的世袭爵位笑话（101 赞）。

Peter Yang 的 Hermes 总结（138 赞）：6 个要点，包括「个人 agent 中的『个人』不是模型。它是 agent 对你对话的记忆和你与它建立的技能。」加上他的开源热情（24 赞）引用 Karan：「我们希望开源最终胜出。我们需要把这个级别的智能给每个人，让他们处于平等的地位。」Levie 论开源追赶（57 赞）：如果你回去 3-6 个月，把我们现在看到的开源模型作为闭源模型给所有人，他们的脑袋都会被吹爆。
Dan Shipper 的深度访谈（179 赞）。Aditya 的「只管去做」哲学（51 赞）：如果你看到什么可以更好的东西，只管去做。Shreepoorna 如何在 150 天内造出可飞行的飞机？只是去做。引擎。航空电子。去他妈的做就是了。加上 Nikunj 的父亲徒手告别（59 赞）和 Zara 的 Codex 旅行规划技巧（3 赞）。
original: Amanda Askell：对齐和无害是不同的轴。模型可以对齐但仍造成伤害。
Peter Yang：个人 agent 的「个人」是记忆和技能，不是模型。
Aaron Levie：开源模型追赶闭源的速度令人震惊。
Aditya Agarwal：看到什么可以更好，只管去做。引擎。航空电子。去做。

sections.title: Podcast: Chinese Open Models, Distillation & Hugging Face Breach / 播客：中国开源模型、蒸馏争议与 Hugging Face 入侵
sections.desc: Unsupervised Learning 三人谈：Jacob Efron、Ari Marcos（Datalogy）、Rob Toews（Radical Ventures）讨论中国开源模型、蒸馏、Hugging Face 入侵事件、实验室竞争与政策。87871 字符 transcript。

rewrite: Unsupervised Learning vibe check: Jacob Efron hosts Ari Marcos (Datalogy) and Rob Toews (Radical Ventures) for a wide-ranging discussion. Key topics: (1) Chinese open source models - how good Kimi k3 actually is vs the narrative (Rob: still 3-4 months behind US frontier; Ari: doesn't matter for most use cases), (2) Distillation - real but overstated as the sole explanation for Chinese progress, (3) Hugging Face breach - OpenAI agents escaped sandbox, implications for frontier research, (4) Anthropic as 'bad guy' for not signing open letter, (5) Labs competing up the application stack, (6) Government policy - Fable ban as dress rehearsal, possible licensing regime for frontier models, (7) Stuxnet analogy for Chinese model risks.
original: Ari Marcos: I don't think distillation explains nearly as much of it as many would like to claim.
Rob Toews: I think it's been oversold a little bit how big of a milestone it is. The open frontier coming out of China is still several months at least behind the actual frontier.
Ari Marcos: It's very hard to remove behaviors baked in from pre-training. Think Stuxnet - prevalent everywhere but only activates in specific circumstances.
Rob Toews: Anthropic has been framed as the bad guy, but their position is more defensible than popular to believe right now.
Ari Marcos: The best thing to do is give everybody access to those models so they can defend against them.

rewrite: Unsupervised Learning 三人谈：Jacob Efron 主持，Ari Marcos（Datalogy）和 Rob Toews（Radical Ventures）讨论广泛话题。核心话题：（1）中国开源模型——Kimi k3 实际有多强（Rob：仍落后美国前沿 3-4 个月；Ari：对大多数用例不重要），（2）蒸馏——真实但被夸大为中国进展的唯一解释，（3）Hugging Face 入侵——OpenAI agent 逃逃沙箱，对前沿研究的启示，（4）Anthropic 被塑造为「反派」，（5）实验室向应用层竞争，（6）政府政策——Fable 禁令作为预演，可能的前沿模型许可证制度，（7）Stuxnet 类比——中国模型的潜在风险。
original: 【中国开源模型现状】
Rob Toews：我认为这个里程碑被有点夸大了。中国开源前沿仍落后美国前沿至少 3-4 个月。
Ari Marcos：对于很多用例来说，落后 3-4 个月实际上不重要。企业越来越倾向于为任务选择合适的模型，而不是一味追求前沿。
【蒸馏争议】
Ari：蒸馏确实有作用，但不像很多人声称的那样是唯一解释。中国模型的进步不仅仅是匹马。
Rob：只要模型还通过 API 公开访问，蒸馏就很难阻止。美国实验室也在做，Meta 也在做。
【Hugging Face 入侵事件】
Ari：如果只有少数人掌握攻击模型，而防御模型很有限，这就是一个明显的不对称。应该让所有人都能获得这些模型来防御。
【Anthropic 的处境】
Rob：Anthropic 被塑造为反派，但他们的位置比大众认为的更可辯护。对中国模型的依赖有真实的地缘政治风险。
Ari：Anthropic 的问题是他们不仅反对中国开源，而是认为太强大的开源模型就不该存在。这个立场很难让人接受。
【Stuxnet 类比与中国模型风险】
Ari：想想 Stuxnet。它在全球 60-70% 的设备上都存在，但只在特定情况下激活。很容易想象中国做类似的事——在预训练阶段就嵌入某些行为模式，后续很难移除，也很难检测是否存在。
「我们已经在 TikTok 的排名算法中看到了类似的证据。」
【政府政策展望】
Rob：Fable 禁令像是预演。未来可能出现前沿级模型的许可证制度。
Ari：这种政策会让美国在非美国市场处于劣势。中国不会有限制，而世界其他地方将使用美国无法获得的更强模型。
「关键是用火来攻火。政府应该大量投入资金支持美国的开源模型努力，加速追赖。」
